channel.title: Social Media Today - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Social Media Today (socialmediatoday.com)

item.title: Meta adds new scam protections to Facebook, WhatsApp and Messenger
item.description: The company also disabled more than 150,000 accounts associated with scam center networks following this year’s Joint Disruption Week.

item.title: Reddit publishes report on its B2B marketing opportunities
item.description: The guide, created in partnership with SurveyMonkey, highlights ways in which brands can gain traction with the platform’s human-curated communities.

item.title: YouTube allocates $20M toward a digital literacy education program for teens
item.description: The video platform, in partnership with Google.org and The Centre for Public Impact, will also work with creators to bring the initiative to audiences.

item.title: Meta adds new tools including freeze frame to Edits
item.description: The new features, which also include a voice-over teleprompter and personalized sound effects, are part of a swiftly expanding suite of creative options in the app.

item.title: Snapchat influences telecommunications purchases
item.description: Users on the app are two times more likely to sign up with a service provider after seeing in-app content from a creator, according to a new report from the company.

item.title: LinkedIn shares tips on optimizing post content for AI chatbots
item.description: The platform published a new guide outlining how users can enhance their content to improve their chances to appear in artificial intelligence answers.

item.title: LinkedIn tests out AI-powered interview screening
item.description: The platform is in the early stages of implementing a feature that will allow hiring professionals to manage initial candidate assessments using artificial intelligence interviewers.

item.title: Snapchat to host AR exhibition at SXSW with Jonathan Yeo
item.description: The app partnered with the portrait artist to showcase the potential for interactive creation and give visitors a chance to test Snap’s AR Specs.

item.title: LinkedIn updates its Feed algorithm
item.description: The professional platform outlined a series of revamped systems to cater more effectively to user interests and better understand contextual relevance.

item.title: Facebook adds AI-powered updates to Marketplace
item.description: New features include artificial intelligence suggestions for listing summaries, prepaid shipping labels and AI-generated profile summaries.
